research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Evernote is researching systems for content associations and sharing for scheduled events, content sharing by pointing to content, and related notes and multi layer search in personal and shared content. Work on fast identification of images in documents and automatic protection of partial document content supports secure, efficient capture. Additional efforts include contextual identification of information feeds during content entry and extracting structured data from handwritten and audio notes, covering capture, organization, retrieval and protection.

overview_description.description:
Evernote builds apps and products that are defining the way individuals and teams work today. As one workspace that lives across people's phone, tablet and computer, Evernote is the place people write free from distraction, collect information, find what they need and present their ideas to the world. Whatever peole are working toward, Evernote’s job is to make sure they get there. 

Evernote is an independent, privately held company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 2007, Evernote products reach more than 100 million users worldwide. With nearly 400 employees and growing, they are always looking for talented individuals to join their global team.

product.description: An Evernote offering for organizations that need shared knowledge management, collaboration, notes, tasks, and content organization for teams.
